If platforms can take our time for free, we should never have to pay to take it back.

Control will never sell a premium version of your attention back to you. The product stays free for everyone and its development is sustained only by people who choose to donate.

Built to answer to you

Control never needs more of your attention to make money.

There is no advertising model behind the product, no paid tier holding back stronger protection, and no personal-data market. The incentive stays simple: help people leave when they intended to.

FAQ

Simple answers.

Everything important, without the fine-print maze.

Is Control free?

Yes. Every core protection is free, with no subscription or premium tier.

How is Control funded?

Only through voluntary donations. Donating never unlocks extra access or changes how the product works.

Where is my data stored?

Your settings and activity stay locally on your device.

Which platforms are supported?

Control is designed for Windows, macOS, iOS and Android.
